summary.fr: Sur le patch 16.22, Heimerdinger support affiche 49,4 % de victoires sur 1 037 parties classées (Émeraude+), tier A. Il souffre surtout contre Leona, Nautilus et Thresh.
summary.en: On patch 16.22, Heimerdinger support has a 49.4% win rate over 1,037 ranked games (Emerald+), A tier. It struggles most against Leona, Nautilus and Thresh.
